pages.text: $(bold)Teapot$(): right-click with items to fill the 4 slots in order.$(br)With the right recipe, $(bold)right-click$() with an empty hand to seal it and start brewing.$(br2)It works automatically and continues batch by batch while sealed; $(bold)shift-right-click$() unseals and refunds all materials, then right-click with an empty hand to collect the results.
